units.source_text: 可是，老头已经不再回头。

en.t: But the old man no longer turned back.

units.source_text: 他像背着沉重的包袱似的，耸着肩膀站起来，才走了三步，就看不见肩膀了，到了第四步，就完全从视野里消失了。

en.t: As if carrying a heavy burden on his back, he rose with his shoulders hunched; after only three steps his shoulders were no longer visible, and by the fourth step he had disappeared completely from sight.
